fusions.name: Velvet Tines
fusions.desc: Gores the target with antlers of bound hair still in velvet, dealing 5 piercing damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Flare
fusions.desc: Every hair on you flares out at once, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Flagged Tail
fusions.desc: Your hair flashes white and you bolt: you spring 2 tiles from where you stood, and for 6 seconds you move 35% faster with 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Prickling Nape
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, the hair on your neck rises: a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
